mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS property_id, p.building_id, p.title, p.property_type, p.trade_type, p.deposit, p.monthly_rent, p.maintenance_fee, p.area_m2, p.floor_info, p.room_number, p.room_num, p.bathroom_num, p.park_availability, p.discussion_status, p.dong, p.property_description, p.move_in_date, p.available_date, p.address, b.road_address, b.jibun_address, b.bld_nm AS building_name, b.latitude, b.longitude FROM property p LEFT JOIN building b ON b.id = p.building_id WHERE p.id = #{propertyId} AND p.seller_id = #{sellerId}
SELECT image_url FROM property_image WHERE property_id = #{propertyId} ORDER BY sort_order

SELECT p.id AS propertyId, p.title, p.property_type AS propertyType, b.bld_nm AS buildingName, p.trade_type AS tradeType, p.deposit, p.monthly_rent AS monthlyRent, p.area_m2 AS areaM2, p.floor_info AS floorInfo, COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) AS favoriteCount, p.transaction_status AS transactionStatus, (SELECT pi.image_url FROM property_image pi WHERE pi.property_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.sort_order LIMIT 1) AS imageUrl FROM property p LEFT JOIN building b ON b.id = p.building_id LEFT JOIN favorite_property f ON f.property_id = p.id WHERE p.seller_id = #{sellerId}
GROUP BY p.id, p.title, p.property_type, b.bld_nm, p.trade_type, p.deposit, p.monthly_rent, p.area_m2, p.floor_info, p.transaction_status ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS `all`, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.transaction_status = 1 THEN p.id END) AS `open`, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.transaction_status = 0 THEN p.id END) AS done, COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) AS favorites FROM property p LEFT JOIN favorite_property f ON f.property_id = p.id WHERE p.seller_id = #{sellerId}
